episodes.title: Le journal du matin, dimanche 22 novembre
episodes.headline_en: The sixth Saturday of protests against the high cost of living in France drew a falling turnout, according to Libération and Le Figaro; the Interior Ministry counted 82,500 marchers, the CGT 150,000
summary_en: The sixth Saturday of protests against the high cost of living in France drew a falling turnout, according to Libération and Le Figaro; the Interior Ministry counted 82,500 marchers, the CGT 150,000
A Russian cargo ship attacked in the Baltic Sea, according to Le Monde and Libération, which reports a Ukrainian drone strike in the Gulf of Finland
The Ain joins the Jura and the Pas-de-Calais in orange vigilance for rain and flooding, Ouest-France writes; Libération reports 800 evacuated in the Pas-de-Calais

episodes.title: Le sport, dimanche 22 novembre
episodes.headline_en: The ATP Finals final in Turin, Carlos Alcaraz v Alexander Zverev, on Sunday 22 November, according to Ouest-France and L'Équipe
summary_en: The ATP Finals final in Turin, Carlos Alcaraz v Alexander Zverev, on Sunday 22 November, according to Ouest-France and L'Équipe
Ligue 1: Lorient host Rennes on Sunday 22 November at 5:15 pm according to Ouest-France and L'Équipe

episodes.title: La météo, dimanche 22 novembre
episodes.headline_en: Marseille today: light rain, 14 to 18 degrees, wind up to 42 km/h, per the Météo-France models
summary_en: Marseille today: light rain, 14 to 18 degrees, wind up to 42 km/h, per the Météo-France models
Bordeaux today: rain, 12 to 16 degrees, wind up to 32 km/h, per the Météo-France models
